crossRefs.note: They will call them “The Holy People, Yahweh’s Redeemed”. You will be called “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken”.

For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. Yahweh your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession…
He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor; and that you may be a holy…

Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid…

Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things; for she has seen that the nations have entered into…
How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of…
But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here…

translations.web: Your holy people possessed it but a little while. Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.
translations.bsb: For a short while Your people possessed Your holy place, but our enemies have trampled Your sanctuary.
translations.kjv: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
translations.asv: Thy holy people possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
